data.Moksha:
The most significant improvements were observed in testing frameworks like QUnit and Groovy Spock, where Copilot provided valuable assistance
Routine coding tasks were expedited, allowing developers to focus more on high-priority and complex issues
With continued use, we anticipate even greater gains in productivity and quality, potentially leading to higher throughput in project deliverables
data.Sprinters:
The improvements observed in case unit testing . Qunit generation is mostly used by all resources who got license. 
Groovy spock code genration , helps manual validation is still required.
Tried code porting from C++ to java. But prompting required inputs would consume more time . Manual was preferred in this case.
With continued usage team would be able to prompt with more relevant inputs and will be able to improve throughput.
